title: Cone domains separate FS-domains from RB-domains
summary: Let $C$ be a closed, convex, pointed and generating cone in a finite-dimensional real vector space $V$, and let \( D_C=(-C)\cup\{\bot\}\) be the negative cone with a new least element, ordered by the cone order. Keimel proved that these cone domains are FS-domains and asked whether they are always retracts of bifinite domains. We give a sharp answer: \[D_C\text{ is an RB-domain}\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad C\text{ is simplicial}. \] Thus every non-simplicial proper cone gives an FS-domain which is not an RB-domain.
